tasks.title: ADR-0034, the task log by default: the decision record and the hub documents (PR A)
tasks.prTitle: docs(design): ADR-0034, the task log by default, and the hub documents it changes (B-476)
tasks.notes: Design-hub documents change (files under design/ only), not a spec or plan. The owner decided on 2026-11-12, in answers to the lead's questions, that every task he asks of the agent is logged by default; the full design is the lead's brief <lead>/reports/task-log-brief-v2.md (1500 lines; it is lead material outside the repository and the single instruction for this work item: read it fully). Write exactly 'PR A' of the brief: section 1 becomes design/docs/adr/0034-task-log-by-default.md from the template design/process/templates/adr.md, Status `Proposed` (hub rule 3: only the owner moves a status to Accepted; say in the ADR header that the decisions were given by the owner on 2026-11-12 and await his acceptance of the written record), with the owner's own words in an Arabic appendix exactly as the brief gives them; section 2.1 lists every hub document to amend and what changes in each (process documents, architecture documents, the ADR README row, the Arabic overview paragraph, the interim hand-written log template under design/process/templates/); section 2.3 gives the rule texts. Follow the hub's own rules in design/AGENTS.md: decisions go through an ADR plus edits to the affected documents in the same change; search the hub for every reference you change (principle numbers, ADR numbers, rule ids A1 to A25, error codes) and keep them consistent; state decisions precisely and briefly; do not duplicate a rule in two places; no private data. Do NOT do what the brief assigns to PR B (the AGENTS template placeholder, root rules, re-rendered AGENTS.md files, .gitattributes, pull request template), to the gate amendment, or to spec and plan 0015: those are separate work items. Where the brief leaves an owner question open (its section 7.3), write it in the ADR as open with the recommendation, do not decide it. The pull request body line is the Plan-Task reason the gate accepts for hub documents: read tools/eng-dev-gate/docs/specs/0001-eng-dev-gate-0.1.md section 4.5 for the exact allowed reasons (the brief says `none (hub documents)`; verify) and how an earlier hub change did it (for example merged pull request for work item B-008 or a recent ADR addition: `git log origin/build/v1 --oneline -- design/docs/adr | head`). Member for the gate run: run `uv run eng-gate check --all --skip mutation` once, or the steps that read design/ if the full run is too slow, and report.

tasks.title: ADR-0034 PR B: the AGENTS template, the workspace root rules and the re-rendered agent files
tasks.prTitle: docs(design): AGENTS template and workspace root rules for the task log (ADR-0034) (B-477)
tasks.notes: Second part of ADR-0034 (merged by B-476): exactly 'PR B' of the lead's brief <lead>/reports/task-log-brief-v2.md section 2.2, with the rule texts of section 2.3: the AGENTS template change (new Never items and the identity rule text as the brief words them, the placeholder for workspace root rules that is empty for packages), the root `.gate/agents.yml` value, the re-render of every AGENTS.md with `eng-gate agents render` (rendered files are generated: never edit them by hand; the agents-drift job must pass), and the root files the brief lists for PR B (.gitattributes scope for tasklog/, the pull request template line). These are protected paths (CODEOWNERS; `.gate/**` has the r3 risk floor): find out from the gate spec and from how earlier template changes were merged (git log for design/process/templates/AGENTS.template.md and .gate/agents.yml) which Plan-Task reason and Risk line such a pull request carries and what `awaiting owner` notices are expected in bootstrap mode; follow that precedent exactly and report it. One protected pull request, as the brief requires (template and re-render together, so that agents-drift stays green on build/v1). Do not create the tasklog/ folder or any log content. If anything the brief asks for PR B cannot be done under the gate rules as they are on build/v1, do not weaken anything: report it with the exact rule. Find the correct workspace member name for the gate run in tools/eng-dev-gate/pyproject.toml and run `uv run eng-gate check --all --skip mutation` before finishing.

Use the templates design/process/templates/feature-spec.md and implementation-plan.md and the front-matter conventions of the neighbouring specs and plans (status draft in bootstrap mode, risk set from the path floors in .gate/risk-map.yml: check RF001; every acceptance criterion covered by some task: GC016; tests_first files inside their task: TF008; each task at most 400 lines: GC005). ADR-0034 (design/docs/adr/0034-task-log-by-default.md, merged by B-476) is the governing decision: the spec must not contradict it; where the brief and the merged ADR differ, the ADR wins and you say so. The spec also carries the amendments of spec 0006 the brief names (the `[tasklog]` configuration section and the `--task` option of run and resume) as edits in spec 0006 itself, each marked as an amendment (B-478). Verify against the merged code and specs every existing name the spec relies on (JournalReader, the result store, the report model, the sanitizer of servers plan T17, the CLI wiring) and correct the brief where the code differs, saying so in your summary. Invent no engineering value. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.
